ReadableChat.Name: Readable chat
ReadableChat.Hint: Show chat messages in a plainer typeface on a flat dark card, keeping the terminal green for headings and labels. Turn off for the system's own chat look.

Builder.OpenHint: Create this character step by step, by the book or with a life path: career, attributes, skills and a talent.
Builder.Title: Character Builder: {name}
Builder.MethodHint: Choose how to create this character. You can come back and change this before applying.

book.Label: By the book
book.Hint: Pick a career, spend your points on attributes and skills, and choose a talent.

lifepath.Label: Life path
lifepath.Hint: Answer questions about your character's history first, then build as the book says.

Commander.Hint: One marine in the unit is in command. Settle with your group who that is.
Commander.Question: Are you the unit commander?

yes.Label: Yes
yes.Hint: You lead the unit. Your rank is {rank}.

no.Label: No
no.Hint: You follow the commander's orders. Your rank is left as it is.

Builder.CareerHint: Your career sets your key attribute, your key skills and the talents you can start with.
Builder.NoCareers: No careers found. Import the rulebook's Career items into the world's Items sidebar.
Builder.AttributesHint: Spend {points} points. Each attribute is at least {min} and at most {max}; {key}, your key attribute, can be {keyMax}.
Builder.SkillsHint: Spend {points} points. A skill can start at {max} at most; your key skills ({keys}) can start at up to {keyMax}.
Builder.TalentHint: Choose one talent from those a {career} starts with.
Builder.TalentNotInWorld: Not in this world's Items, so it can't be added for you.
Builder.ReviewHint: Check your choices. Nothing on the character changes until you apply them.
Builder.ReplaceNote: This character already has scores. Applying replaces its attributes, skills and career.
Builder.ReplaceWarning: {name} already has attributes. Applying replaces its attributes, skills and career, and adds the talent.
Builder.Applied: {name} is built. Name, appearance, agenda, gear and cash are still yours to fill in.
Builder.CareerGone: That career is no longer in the world's Items.
Builder.TalentMissing: {name} isn't in this world's Items, so add that talent by hand.

Rules.ActionsHint: Each round you can perform one full action and one quick action, or two quick actions.

FullNotes.FullCover: Ranged attacks against you get –3 dice and must penetrate the barrier. You cannot dodge. Cluttered zones only.

QuickNotes.PartialCover: Ranged attacks against you get –2 dice. You can still dodge. Cluttered zones only.
QuickNotes.Defend: Declare before the attacker rolls. Each success you roll cancels one of the attacker's.
QuickNotes.Aim: +2 dice to the attack. Short range or more, on your turn immediately before the attack.
QuickNotes.Dodge: Declare before the attacker rolls. Each success you roll cancels one of the attacker's. Not possible in full cover.
QuickNotes.Rally: On a success they are no longer broken and recover 1 Health per success.

Quick.MoveRange: Move between Short and Adjacent range
Quick.MoveDoor: Move to a door or hatch and peek through
Quick.Defend: Defend against a close combat attack
Quick.PickUp: Pick up an item from the ground

ALTSHEET.EditModeOn: Editing: attributes, skill ranks, name and career are unlocked. Click to lock.
ALTSHEET.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit attributes, skill ranks, name and career.
ALTSHEET.Limited: You only have limited access to this character.
ALTSHEET.CareerDrop: Drag a Career or Specialty item here
ALTSHEET.CareerLegacy: Set on the system's sheet. Drag a Career item here to replace it.
ALTSHEET.RollHint: Click a button to roll. Shift-click, right-click or the slider button to add modifiers first.
ALTSHEET.NoWeapons: No weapons equipped. Equip one on the Gear tab.
ALTSHEET.NoType: Set a weapon type (ranged or melee) on the item to roll it.
ALTSHEET.NoTalents: No talents yet. Drag one here from a compendium.
ALTSHEET.StateLegend: Equipped items count for armor, supplies and bonuses. Carried items only add weight. Stowed items are in your foot locker and weigh nothing.

State.EquippedTip: Equipped: counts for armor, supplies and bonuses
State.CarriedTip: Carried: in your pack, adds weight only
State.StoredTip: Stowed in your foot locker: no weight

ALTSHEET.NoItems: Nothing here. Drag items in from a compendium or the Items sidebar.

Creature.EditModeOn: Editing: name, health, stats, skills, tables and special abilities are unlocked. Click to lock.
Creature.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit name, health, stats, skills, tables and special abilities.
Creature.Limited: You only have limited access to this creature.
Creature.RollHint: Click a button to roll. Shift-click, right-click or the button beside it to add modifiers or pick a result first.
Creature.SpeedHint: How many initiative cards the creature draws each round. It isn't rolled.
Creature.AttackTip: Roll on the creature's attack table and post the result to chat
Creature.PickAttackTable: No attack table set. Turn Edit on to pick one.
Creature.NoAttackTable: This creature's attack table isn't in the world.
Creature.AcidTip: Asks for the damage dealt to the creature, then rolls the splash
Creature.PickCritTable: No critical injury table set. Turn Edit on to pick one.

Vehicle.EditModeOn: Editing: name, hull, armor, speed, manoeuvrability, passengers, cost and description are unlocked. Click to lock.
Vehicle.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit name, hull, armor, speed, manoeuvrability, passengers, cost and description.
Vehicle.Limited: You only have limited access to this vehicle.
Vehicle.NoCrew: No crew. Drag characters or synthetics here from the Actors sidebar.
Vehicle.AttackTip: Asks who is firing, the range and any modifiers, then rolls
Vehicle.NoWeapons: No weapons. Drag one here or add it on the Cargo tab.
Vehicle.CargoHint: Weapons listed here are the ones on the Vehicle tab. Drag items in from a compendium or the Items sidebar.
Vehicle.ManoeuvrabilityHint: Added to the pilot's Piloting rolls.

Spacecraft.EditModeOn: Editing: name, hull, armor, thrusters, signature and the ship's details are unlocked. Click to lock.
Spacecraft.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit name, hull, armor, thrusters, signature and the ship's details.
Spacecraft.Limited: You only have limited access to this ship.
Spacecraft.ShowImage: Show the ship's image full size
Spacecraft.DamageHint: Damage taken, out of the ship's hull rating.
Spacecraft.ThrustersHint: Added to the pilot's Piloting rolls.
Spacecraft.PhasesHint: Pick what the ship does in a phase, then announce it to the chat.

Territory.EditModeOn: Editing: name, description and sectors are unlocked. Click to lock.
Territory.EditModeOff: Locked for reading. Click to edit name, description and sectors.
Territory.Limited: You only have limited access to this territory.
Territory.NoSystems: No systems. Drag Planet/System items here or add one.

Colony.EditModeOn: Editing: name, stats, who heads each and the colony's details are unlocked. Click to lock.
Colony.EditModeOff: Locked for play. Click to edit name, stats, who heads each and the colony's details.
Colony.Limited: You only have limited access to this colony.
Colony.Head: Head
Colony.NoInitiatives: None. Drag a Colony Initiative here or add one.

Planet.EditModeOff: Locked for reading. Click to edit name, the star system, the world and its surface.

Item.ComputerRoll: Roll for the computer. Right-click to add modifiers first.
Item.ModifiersHint: Bonuses and penalties this gives whoever has it equipped.
